cobblemon.ability.normalmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Normal-immune Pokémon with Normal-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Normal-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.firemastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Fire-immune Pokémon with Fire-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.watermastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Water-immune Pokémon with Water-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Water-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.grassmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Fire-immune Pokémon with Grass-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.icemastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ice-immune Pokémon with Ice-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Ice-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.electricmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Electric-immune Pokémon with Electric-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.psychicmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Psychic-immune Pokémon with Psychic-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Psychic-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.dragonmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Dragon-immune Pokémon with Dragon-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Dragon-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.fairymastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Fairy-immune Pokémon with Fairy-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Fairy-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Def stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.ghostmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-immune Pokémon with Ghost-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Ghost-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.fightingmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Fighting-immune Pokémon with Fighting-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Fighting-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.flyingmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Flying-immune Pokémon with Flying-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Flying-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.poisonmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Poison-immune Pokémon with Poison-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Poison-type moves. Instead, its Sp. Def stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.groundmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ground-immune Pokémon with Ground-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Ground-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.rockmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Rock-immune Pokémon with Rock-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Rock-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.steelmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Steel-immune Pokémon with Steel-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Steel-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.bugmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Bug-immune Pokémon with Bug-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Bug-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.darkmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Dark-immune Pokémon with Dark-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Dark-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.
cobblemon.ability.sweetdreams.desc: Heals ally Pokémon that are asleep.
cobblemon.battle.heal.sweetdreams: %1$s restored a little HP from Sweet Dreams!
cobblemon.ability.bombard.desc: Powers up ball and bomb moves.
cobblemon.ability.hotsand.desc: The Pokémon body is made of hot sand that prevents it from being burned. Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
cobblemon.ability.forestspirit.desc: Powers up the Grass-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
cobblemon.ability.shrieker.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon is also immune to these kinds of moves.
cobblemon.ability.windcharge.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
cobblemon.ability.darklord.desc: Powers up Dark-type moves. Also halves damage taken from Dark-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.intellectual.desc: Powers up Psychic-type moves. Also halves damage taken from Psychic-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.paperthin.desc: The Pokémon is made of paper, causing it to catch fire when hit by Fire-type moves, and soaked when hit by Water-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.misdirection.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user. This however prevents the use of protecting moves.
cobblemon.ability.turbocharge.desc: The Pokémon is turbocharged with electricity, which powers up Electric-type moves and halves the damage taken from Electric-type moves. When hit by an electric type move, its speed stat is boosted.
cobblemon.ability.recluse.desc: The Pokémon is reclusive, keeping it from or falling for taunt, torment, or encore. This also lowers the Pokémon's Speed stat if intimidated.
cobblemon.ability.zendomain.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The Pokémon also gradually regains HP in Psychic Terrain.
cobblemon.ability.mastermind.desc: Normal-type moves become Psychic-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.hivemind.desc: Powers up the Bug-type and Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
cobblemon.ability.snowforce.desc: Boosts the power of Ice-type moves in snow.
cobblemon.ability.blindfold.desc: The Pokémon is blind. Because of this, it takes no damage from light moves.
cobblemon.ability.lifelight.desc: The Pokémon's body absorbs all light. If hit by a light move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
cobblemon.ability.lightforce.desc: The Pokémon's body emits a blinding aura that powers up the user's light moves.
cobblemon.ability.greathunger.desc: The Pokémon restores a little HP every time it inflicts damage on others using biting moves.
cobblemon.ability.mistrider.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Misty Terrain.
cobblemon.ability.liquify.desc: Normal-type moves become Water-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.ignition.desc: Normal-type moves become Fire-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.cultivate.desc: Normal-type moves become Grass-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.tinkerer.desc: Lowers the Defense stats of all opposing Steel-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.aeroforce.desc: The Pokémon's aura powers up the user's wind moves.
cobblemon.ability.restoration.desc: The Pokémon's HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout a battle. It heals a little extra in harsh sunlight.
cobblemon.ability.spikedheels.desc: Increases the critical-hit ratio of the user's kicking moves.
cobblemon.ability.sweetdish.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in Misty Terrain.
cobblemon.ability.strongarm.desc: Powers up throwing and grappling moves. This also protects it from being forced to switch out.
cobblemon.battle.activate.strongarm: %1$s's Strong Arm kept it in place!
cobblemon.ability.rapidfists.desc: Gives priority to the Pokémon's punching moves.
cobblemon.ability.resilient.desc: It's so resilient that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.ability.reverberation.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by sound moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
cobblemon.ability.sandguard.desc: Prevents status conditions and boosts the user's Defense in sandstorms.
cobblemon.ability.echoburst.desc: Scatters echo shards in the air around the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
cobblemon.ability.gourmand.desc: The Pokémon builds up a stockpile when it eats any berry.
cobblemon.ability.mightymycelium.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk but prevents the use of status moves.
cobblemon.ability.netcaster.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it casts a net on opposing Pokémon and makes them slower, lowering their Speed stats.
cobblemon.ability.steelsoul.desc: Normal-type moves become Steel-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.windglider.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
cobblemon.ability.trapjaw.desc: Biting moves entrap the target, causing them to take damage for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
cobblemon.battle.activate.trapjaw: The target was caught in the Trap-Jaw!
cobblemon.ability.acidspit.desc: The Pokémon spits acid on attackers that make direct contact with it. The fluid eliminates the effect of the attacker's Ability.
cobblemon.ability.tastyaroma.desc: The Pokémon has a tasty aroma that redirects all biting moves towards it. It evades redirected attacks, making it immune to biting moves.
cobblemon.battle.activate.tastyaroma: %1$s distracted them with its tasty aroma!
cobblemon.ability.championsmask.desc: The Pokémon can use \"not very effective\" moves to deal regular damage.
cobblemon.ability.rectitude.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted by its sense of justice.
cobblemon.move.pumpkinbomb.desc: The user attacks everything around it by igniting an explosive pumpkin. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.firebomb.desc: The throws a flaming explosive at the target, leaving them with a burn.
cobblemon.move.bulletbarrage.desc: The user forcefully shoots metal bullets at the target two to five times in a row.
cobblemon.move.digdeep.desc: The user digs into the target using its body as a pickaxe. This move is super effective on Ground-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.move.dragonpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.magictrick.desc: The user performs a magic trick to switch its Attack with its Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.battle.activate.magictrick: %1$s switched its Attack and Sp. Atk!
cobblemon.move.nightterror.desc: The user devours the dreams of a sleeping target, leaving behind nothing but nightmares. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.sleepcharm.desc: The user sprinkles magic sand onto the opponent to put them to sleep. If it succeeds, the user restores 1/4th of their HP.
cobblemon.move.sandshift.desc: The user shoots sand at the target before rushing to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
cobblemon.move.sonicshriek.desc: The user attacks by firing a sonically-charged shriek from its chest.
cobblemon.move.terrainblade.desc: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
cobblemon.move.vitaldrain.desc: The user latches onto the target's vitals to drain them of their blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.vitalslash.desc: The user slashes the target's vitals to drain them of their blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.phantomblade.desc: The user tears at the target with its ghostly blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and never misses.
cobblemon.move.steelcutter.desc: The user slashes the target with steel blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.snowbank.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in snow or hail.
cobblemon.move.pitfall.desc: The user creates a pitfall to trip the target. This move enables the user to attack first, but fails if the target is not readying an attack.
cobblemon.move.breezeball.desc: The user hurls a wind charge at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
cobblemon.move.papercut.desc: The user attacks by slicing the target with a blade as thin as paper. This move always lands a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.bygonebash.desc: The user throws a mighty punch using combined power of the spirits of its ancestors. This also damages the user quite a lot.
cobblemon.move.psychicsnap.desc: The user sends out a shockwave of psychic power capable of shattering glass. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
cobblemon.move.generationdance.desc: The user performs the dance of its ancestors, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in harsh sunlight.
cobblemon.move.shiverdance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, shivering dance. This boosts the user's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. The user's Attack and Sp. Atk stat are raised sharply when its snowing.
cobblemon.move.magicmissile.desc: The user attacks the target by casting a mighty spell. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.
cobblemon.move.guardpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its stone body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.armorpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its armored body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.mindbend.desc: The user attacks the target with mental fortitude. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.glacialcrash.desc: The user attacks by slamming its icy body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.psydrive.desc: The user delivers an powerful psychic kick to attack the target. This move deals special damage.
cobblemon.move.eeriedance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, unsettling dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
cobblemon.move.crystalspear.desc: The user pierces the target with a crystalline spear. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and never misses.
cobblemon.move.fleurdance.desc: The user performs an elegant flowery dance to strike the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
cobblemon.move.dragonfang.desc: The target is bitten with draconic fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.thunderclaw.desc: The user attacks by slashing the target with electrified claws. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.spiritdrain.desc: The user uses its ghostly power to drain the target's life force. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.flyingkick.desc: The user jumps forward to kick the target it midair. This may also make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.zekromkick.desc: The user delivers a powerful Zekrom Kick! This move is Dragon and Electric type simultaneously. This may also make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.reshirambeam.desc: The user fires off a powerful Reshiram Beam! This move is Dragon and Electric type simultaneously. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.nightlight.desc: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a dark light. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.nosedive.desc: The user flies into the air and dives down to attack the opponent. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
cobblemon.move.flashbang.desc: The user emits a powerful flash of light to inflict damage on everything around it. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
cobblemon.move.lockin.desc: The user shakes off their nerves to face the battle ahead. This move boosts the user's Attack, Defense, and Sp. Def stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
cobblemon.move.feyblade.desc: The user slashes the target using a magical key as a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.turntail.desc: The user cowardly rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting, restoring its own HP by up to one third its max HP.
cobblemon.move.stormsiphon.desc: The user draws in lightning to restore its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather and terrain.
cobblemon.move.dragonaxe.desc: The user swings its axe-like tusks to attack the target. This attack leaves behind Steel splinters that can damage opponents.
cobblemon.move.fivestarpunch.desc: A consecutive five-punch attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.vinepress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its plant-like body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.phantomtrick.desc: The user performs a ghostly trick to switch its Attack with its Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.battle.activate.phantomtrick: %1$s switched its Attack and Sp. Atk!
cobblemon.move.hammerdown.desc: The user launches a rock into the air with its might hammer. Flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when they're hit. This move is also super effective on Steel types.
cobblemon.move.relicdance.desc: The user performs an ancient dance. This raises the user's Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats and also changes Meloetta's form.
cobblemon.move.boltbeam.desc: The user attacks with a beam of electricity. This may also paralyze the target.
cobblemon.move.psyclone.desc: The user employs its power to attack by wrapping its opponent in a fierce psychic wind. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.rainbowwing.desc: The user attacks by showering the target with rainbow feathers. If its raining this move makes the weather sunny and creates a rainbow above your team's side. This doesn't work in heavy rain however.
cobblemon.move.obliquekick.desc: The user stomps down on the opponent's knee. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
cobblemon.move.dropkix.desc: The user flips into the air to kick down towards the opponent. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
cobblemon.move.showdownmode.desc: The user decides to fight all out, standing on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. This raises the user's Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats for three turns, but lowers Defense and Sp. Def when those three turns run out.
cobblemon.battle.end.showdownmode: %1$s exited Showdown Mode, its now fatigued!
cobblemon.move.guardcoat.desc: The user attacks by slamming its fluffy body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals. This move's effects vary depending on what trim the user has.
cobblemon.move.pamper.desc: The user pampers itself to raise its stats. This move's effects vary depending on what trim the user has.
cobblemon.move.shadowstars.desc: The user attacks by shooting dark throwing stars at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
cobblemon.move.starshower.desc: The user attacks by showering the target with stars. This move hits two to five times in a row. This move also does increased damage if the user has used Cosmic Power previously.
cobblemon.move.quickfire.desc: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.backpetal.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
cobblemon.move.butterflylanding.desc: The user delicately lands on the ground to rest its wings. After using this move, the user will no longer be Flying type and their moves will have an increased likelihood of additional effects occuring.
cobblemon.move.sugarcrash.desc: The user attacks the target with sugary sweets. This may also lower the target's speed.
cobblemon.move.softserve.desc: The user restores the HP of itself or an ally by up to half of the target's max HP. It regains more HP in Misty Terrain or snow and hail.
cobblemon.move.mountainstorm.desc: The user attacks by striking the target with a fierce punch before throwing them over its shoulder. This move always lands a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.valleydrop.desc: The user attacks by grabbing the target and tripping them up, causing them to fall onto their back. This lowers the target's Speed stat, but also damages the user a little.
cobblemon.move.dragonsfist.desc: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
cobblemon.move.volatileextract.desc: The user emits an incredibly volatile extract. For three turns, all stat changes affecting the target become the opposite of what they were. The target's stat changes return to normal after the effect runs out.
cobblemon.battle.start.volatileextract: A volatile scent wafted into the air!
cobblemon.move.chillout.desc: The user blows cold wind at the target to inflict frostbite.
cobblemon.move.tripletumble.desc: The user stumbles around crashing into the target. This hits three times and becomes more powerful with each successful hit, but randomly lowers the user's Attack, Defense, or Speed stats for each hit.
cobblemon.move.hypnoblast.desc: The user attacks the target with great psychic power. However, this also lowers the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
cobblemon.move.marinelight.desc: The user shines an eerie hypnotic light at the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.move.seismicwave.desc: The user shakes the ground with a seismic wave to attack the target. This move deals special damage.
cobblemon.move.stoneage.desc: A column of stone hits the target. When used with its steel counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a trap of steel spikes appears. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
cobblemon.move.iceage.desc: A column of ice hits the target. When used with its rock counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a trap of ice shards appears. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
cobblemon.move.ironage.desc: A column of steel hits the target. When used with its ice counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a mirror shield appears to protect your team from wide-ranging attacks for 5 turns.
cobblemon.move.echoshards.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating echo shards around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.opponent.echo: Echo Shards surround the enemy team!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.opponent.echosh: The Echo Shards disappeared from around the opposing team!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.ally.echoshards: The Echo Shards disappeared from around your team!
cobblemon.move.deepfreeze.desc: The user attacks by super-freezing the air around the target. This also leaves the target with frostbite.
cobblemon.move.frigidwater.desc: The user attacks by shooting frigid cold water at the target. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent in snow or hail. This may also leave the target with frostbite.
cobblemon.move.cargothrow.desc: The user attacks by grabbing the target with one of its arms, making the target unable to flee. If used against a target that has already been grabbed, the target is thrown and a different Pokémon is dragged out.
cobblemon.move.giantpunch.desc: The user attacks the target by throwing a powerful gorilla punch. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
cobblemon.move.honeydew.desc: The honey gathered is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more honey is gathered, the more HP is restored.
cobblemon.move.honeybomb.desc: The user fires a ball of honey at the target. The more honey is gathered, the greater the move's power. This also lowers the user's speed.
cobblemon.move.leviathanpulse.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by shooting twin pulses of condensed water. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
cobblemon.move.guardianbeam.desc: The user attacks the target by shooting a mysterious beam out of its eye. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move, and this attack never misses.
cobblemon.move.tigerbridge.desc: The user grabs the target and performs a reckless backbreaker rack drop. This also damages the user a little.
cobblemon.move.ensnare.desc: The power of this attack move is doubled if it's used on a target that's switching out of battle.
cobblemon.move.mantisstrike.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
cobblemon.move.potshot.desc: The user fires a quick shot at the unsuspecting target. This move usually goes first and has a heightened chance of landing a critical-hit, but isn't always an accurate shot.
cobblemon.move.fossilfang.desc: The user bites into the target with sharp rock-like fangs. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
cobblemon.move.terrabite.desc: The user viciously bites the target to hold them in place. The target becomes unable to flee.
cobblemon.move.ironfang.desc: The user bites with sharp metal fangs. This may also make the target flinch or lower the target's Defense stat.
cobblemon.move.seamitarslash.desc: The user strikes using hidden blades, slashing faster than the blink of an eye. This move never misses and has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This move also deals physical damage.
cobblemon.move.triplefury.desc: The user jabs the target three times in succession using its sharp beak. This move usually goes first. When used by Dodrio, sometimes all three heads will act in unison, doubling the move's power.
cobblemon.move.rootout.desc: The user goes all out and attacks the target by tearing its own roots out of the ground. This lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats. This also increases in power if the user is ingrained, but they uproot themselves in the process.
cobblemon.move.conjuringfire.desc: The user burns its item in order to cast a fiery spell. This move's effects change depending on the user's held item. The item is consumed after use.
cobblemon.move.soakup.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in rain.
cobblemon.move.slickslime.desc: The user coats itself in a slippery slime that increases it Sp. Def and prevents it from being trapped or bound by moves. This also prevents the user's speed from being lowered by the opponent's attacks.
cobblemon.battle.activate.slickslime: %1$s's Slick Slime allowed it to escape!
cobblemon.battle.block.slickslime: %1$s's Slick Slime allowed it to escape!
cobblemon.move.slimeball.desc: The user throws a ball of slime at the target. If the user has any slime layers, this attack lowers the target's Speed stat. This moves power increases depending on how many layers of slime the user has.
cobblemon.move.dragontrap.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying a special attack.
cobblemon.move.heliobeam.desc: The user gathers light and recovers HP on the first turn, then blasts an electric beam on the next turn.
